fieldValues.title: SQLite only as a rebuildable index over the files
fieldValues.move: When registry-wide find is too slow, add an index in srs-projection built from the files and thrown away at will (the notmuch pattern), never a store the files are loaded from. Keep ADR-041 section 5 as the answer to the SQL question.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Live multi-user editing; that is not a storage problem.
fieldValues.falsifier: A query the index cannot answer without becoming the source of truth.
fieldValues.return_when: find across the registry exceeds an interactive budget.
